figurative_meaning_en: caught in a crime or arrested
example_sentences_in_bangla: চোরকে হাতে দড়ি দিয়ে পুলিশ ধরে ফেলেছে।
সে অপরাধে জড়িয়ে হাতে দড়ি পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The thief was caught with the rope in his hand by the police.
He got caught in the crime and ended up with the rope in his hand.
history: This idiom originates from traditional methods of restraining criminals with ropes before modern handcuffs were introduced in rural and semi-urban Bengal.
note: Reflects pre-colonial policing practices in Bengali society.
